title: Add records-history cutover: import and exempt record at C0 on landing
summary: Add [history] cutover_job to config and athena.toml; when athena land --pr lands that job, run the records importer at C0 (landing record's host commit) and write the legacy-exempt record. Make athena check --history judge commits up to C0 by old rules and later ones by the attribution check, unchanged before C0 exists; CI keeps its name and fetches athena/records first.

defaults_applied.how: New tests for cutover landing and history split; cargo test and clippy clean.
Criteria check import commit, exempt record and pass/fail of commits around C0.
Behavior criteria runnable via cargo test.
Cutover enforced in code and CI, not prose.
BRIEF.md asks for tagged releases and a changelog, so the change records itself in CHANGELOG.md.

assumptions: Goal: make the records-history cutover happen automatically when the named job lands, so maintainers and CI judge post-C0 commits by records rather than trailers.
The job's own id is not visible to me; the producer must take it from the job context when setting cutover_job.
Existing records_import, attribution.rs and exempt config exist and are reused rather than rebuilt.
Trailers continue to be written; ending them is out of scope.
Governance files athena.toml and ci.yml change as listed.

acceptance_criteria.text: Run `cargo test`: a scratch-repository test lands a job named by [history] cutover_job via the land path and shows the records branch has the landing record, an import commit with import-manifest.json whose self-check passes, and the legacy-exempt record (six exempt entries plus 02837e0 with reasons), with C0 resolved from the landing record's host commit.

Run `cargo test`: a history test shows a commit at or before C0 judged by the old trailer rules, and a commit after C0 judged only by the attribution check against records, so a later records-only commit without a trailer passes.
Run `cargo test`: with no cutover_job set, or before its landing record exists on the records branch, all pre-existing history-check tests pass unchanged (no edits to their expectations).

athena.toml [history] has cutover_job set to this job's own id; config.rs parses it as optional; .github/workflows/ci.yml keeps the job name 'the full history' and fetches athena/records before the history check.
docs/decisions.md records the cutover design (C0 definition, import at C0, exempt record, behavior before C0, trailers still written) and CHANGELOG.md has an entry.
Run `cargo clippy` and `cargo fmt --check`: both clean.

out_of_scope: Later parts of job 7 or other records-history jobs
departures: Multi-crate change touching land path, history check, and CI; larger than typical, so cost and time raised and pass probability lowered.
